1441.name: Lib. Abjuration
desc:
The inscription reads:
 "In accordance with the ancient
  pact, may the bane be lifted from
  thy forbidden draught."
Necessary in purifying the cursed
beverage.

desc:

 "In accordance with the ancient

Necessary in purifying the cursed soup.

1443.name: Dried Mugwort
desc: This spice is said to assist digestion.

1444.name: Divine Sap
desc: Sap extracted from a divine tree.

1445.name: Freya's Tear
desc:
This rare, tear-shaped jewel has
a luxurious shine.

1446.name: Lacquer Tree Log
desc: A rough-cut log of lacquer tree timber.

1447.name: Lqr. Tree Lbr.
desc: Processed lacquer tree lumber.

1448.name: Lqr. Tree Sap
desc: Sap extracted from the lacquer tree.

1449.name: T. Whiteshell
desc:
This ancient Windurstian currency,
valuing 1 mumu, dates back to C.E.
294. The engraving commemorates the
joining of the Tarutaru tribes and the
establishment of the Federation.

1450.name: L. Jadeshell
desc:
This ancient Windurstian currency,
valuing 100 mumus, dates back to C.E.
373. The engraving commemorates the
warlord Lungo-Nango's invasion of
Elvaan occupied Southern Quon.

1451.name: R. Stripeshell
desc:
This ancient Windurstian currency,
valuing 10,000 mumus, dates back to
C.E. 719. The engraving commemorates
the 500 year anniversary of Star
Sibyl Rimilala's discovery of magic.

1452.name: O. Bronzepiece
desc:
This ancient San d'Orian currency,
valuing 1 noit, dates back to C.E. 491.
It commemorates the Royal Knights
and the knights' first captain, Lord
Fainevlure Ordelle.

1453.name: M. Silverpiece
desc:
This ancient San d'Orian currency,
valuing 100 noits, dates back to C.E.
563. It commemorates the hero of the
First Battle of Konschtat, Lady
Eldie Montiont.

1454.name: R. Goldpiece
desc:
This ancient San d'Orian currency,
valuing 10,000 noits, dates back to
C.E. 830. It commemorates the slaying
of the evil black dragon by Ranperre
d'Oraguille.

1455.name: 1 Byne Bill
desc:
This ancient Bastokan currency dates
back to C.E. 857. It commemorates the
opening of the ferry route between
Mhaura and Selbina. A musket and a
Galkan soldier are portrayed.

1456.name: 100 Byne Bill
desc:
This ancient Bastokan currency dates
back to C.E. 857. It commemorates the
opening of the ferry route between
Mhaura and Selbina. A machine cog and
a Hume technician are portrayed.

1457.name: 10,000 Byne Bill
desc:
This ancient Bastokan currency dates
back to C.E. 857. It commemorates the
opening of the ferry route between
Mhaura and Selbina. The Metalworks
and a laborer's raised fist are
portrayed.

1458.name: Mammoth Tusk
desc:
The tusks of the legendary mammoth
are prized by bonecrafters across
Vana'diel.

1459.name: Griffon Leather
desc:
Remarkably light and sturdy
griffon leather.

1460.name: Koh-I-Noor
desc:
This transparent jewel is larger than
a bird egg.

1461.name: Wootz Ingot
desc:
Wootz ore was added during this
steel's smelting process.

1462.name: Lancewood Lbr.
desc: Processed lancewood lumber.

1463.name: Chronos Tooth
desc: An enormous petrified tooth.

1464.name: Lancewood Log
desc: A rough-cut log of lancewood timber.

1465.name: Granite
desc:
A large, smooth piece of
speckled granite.

1466.name: Relic Iron
desc:
These unidentifiable iron items were
forged centuries ago.

1467.name: Relic Steel
desc:
This type of steel is formed by
refining piles of relic iron.

1468.name: Marksman's Oil
desc:
Applying this lubricant drastically
improves the performance of all
firearms.

1469.name: Wootz Ore
desc:
This ore contains a natural form of
the wootz alloy.

1470.name: Sparkling Stone
desc:
Translucent gems are embedded in
this large stone.

1471.name: Sticky Rice
desc:
This grain is imported from a land far
to the east. When cooked, it has a
consistency slightly more glutinous
than normal Tarutaru rice.

1472.name: Gardenia Seed
desc:
This spice is used to make dyes and
ward off evil spirits.

1473.name: H.Q. Scp. Shell
desc:
The quality of this scorpion shell is
beyond compare.

1474.name: Infinity Core
desc: The heart of a simulacrum.

1475.name: Curry Powder
desc:
Over eleven herbs and spices have
been blended to form this pungent
powder. The mixture is said to have
originated in a land far to the south.

1476.name: Xhifhut Strings
desc:
These animal hairs are bound to the
body of the instrument known as the
xhifhut. The sound created by the
xhifhut closely resembles the fricative
noises made within the Antica's necks.

1477.name: Xhifhut Body
desc:
This hollow wooden case is the body
of the instrument known as the
xhifhut. The sound created by the
xhifhut closely resembles the fricative
noises made within the Antica's necks.

1478.name: Xhifhut Bow
desc:
This bow is used when playing the
instrument known as the xhifhut. The
sound created by the xhifhut closely
resembles the fricative noises made
within the Antica's necks.

1479.name: Xhifhut Head
desc:
This tuning device is attached to the
body of the instrument known as the
xhifhut. The sound created by the
xhifhut closely resembles the fricative
noises made within the Antica's necks.

1480.name: Mermaid Head
desc:
This shrunken head is often mistaken
for that of a mermaid. However, it is
simply the mummified remains of an
Opo-opo, used by the Sahagin when
bartering with the pirates of Norg.

1481.name: Mermaid Body
desc:
This shriveled body is often mistaken
for that of a mermaid. However, it is
simply the mummified remains of an
Opo-opo, used by the Sahagin when
bartering with the pirates of Norg.

1482.name: Mermaid Hands
desc:
These shrunken hands are often
mistaken for those of a mermaid.
However, they are simply the
mummified remains of an Opo-opo,
used by the Sahagin when bartering
with the pirates of Norg.

1483.name: Mermaid Tail
desc:
This shriveled tail is often mistaken
for that of a mermaid. However, it is
simply the mummified remains of a
pugil, used by the Sahagin when
bartering with the pirates of Norg.

1484.name: Rancor Mantle
desc:
This type of weblike mantle is used in
the lanterns of Tonberry assassins. The
lantern's mysterious light is said to
have hypnotic powers.

1485.name: Rancor Globe
desc:
This globe, constructed from thin
beetle shells, is found on the lanterns
of Tonberry assassins. The lantern's
mysterious light is said to have
hypnotic powers.

1486.name: Rancor Tank
desc:
This putrid-smelling tank is found on
the lanterns of Tonberry assassins. The
lantern's mysterious light is said to
have hypnotic powers.

1487.name: Rancor Handle
desc:
This Hume bone lid and handle is found
on the lanterns of Tonberry assassins.
The lantern's mysterious light is said
to have hypnotic powers.

1514.name: Chocobo Ticket
desc:
This "free ride" ticket is part of a
campaign by the chocobo stables to
encourage more adventurers to utilize
their services.

1515.name: Fang Arrowhd.
desc: The striking tips of fang arrows.

1516.name: Griffon Hide
desc: The lustrous hide of a griffon.

1517.name: Giant Frozen Head
desc:
The head of what looks like an
enormous mammal lies encased within
this block of ice.

1518.name: Colossal Skull
desc:
This giant, half-petrified skull closely
resembles that of a Hume.

1519.name: Fresh Orc Liver
desc:
This pungent liver was only recently
cut out of a healthy Orc.

1520.name: Goblin Grease
desc:
A Goblin Alchemist has brewed this
lubricant from a secret recipe.

1521.name: Slime Juice
desc:
Only certain, rare species of slime
produce this highly sought-after fluid.

1522.name: Fresh Marjoram
desc:
When dried, this spice is useful for
getting rid of unpleasant odors.

1523.name: Apple Mint
desc:
This herb is said to have relaxing
properties as well as assist digestion.
It has a light, apple scent.

1524.name: Fresh Mugwort
desc:
When dried, this spice is said to assist
digestion.

1525.name: Adamantoise Egg
desc:
The tiny egg of an adamantoise.
Due to the traces of metal found
in their shells, these eggs are often
mistaken for chunks of ore.

1526.name: Wyrm Beard
desc:
This beard of the legendary wyrm is
actually an overgrown scale taken from
under its chin.

1527.name: Behemoth Tongue
desc:
This giant tongue of the behemoth is
covered with hundreds of tiny lumps.

1528.name: Red Cryptex
desc:
A red stone used by the Orcs to
deliver orders. The red color signifies
"Ronfaure," and the number of nails
imbedded in its surface signifies
"Attack."

1529.name: Dst. Engraving
desc:
A sheet of darksteel used by the
Quadav to deliver orders. Upon it is a
map of Gustaberg with arrows
indicating an invasion route.

1530.name: 7-Knot Quipu
desc:
A knotted rope used by the Yagudo to
deliver orders. The type of knot
signifies the order (attack), while the
number of knots signifies the location
(Sarutabaruta).

1531.name: Galka Fang Sack
desc:
A fang-filled bag used by Goblin
thieves to relay messages. It is
believed that the type of fang (Galka)
represents the place of meeting
(Zulkheim).

1532.name: Jade Cryptex
desc:
A green stone used by the Orcs to
deliver orders. The green color
signifies "Norvallen," and the number
of nails imbedded in its surface
signifies "Attack."

1533.name: Silver Engraving
desc:
A sheet of silver used by the
Quadav to deliver orders. Upon it
is a map of Derfland with arrows
indicating an invasion route.

1534.name: Mithra Fang Sack
desc:
A fang-filled bag used by Goblin
thieves to relay messages. It is 
believed that the type of fang (Mithra)
represents the place of meeting
(Kolshushu).

1535.name: 13-Knot Quipu
desc:
A knotted rope used by the Yagudo to
deliver orders. The type of knot
signifies the order (attack), while the
number of knots signifies the location
(Aragoneu).
